Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - The Half G.overview: Lachlan Giles' bottom half guard anthology, eight volumes (about 11 hours). Volume 1 covers concepts and entries. Volume 2 covers recovering to half guard from bad positions. Volume 3 covers the knee shield and getting the underhook. Volume 4 covers the underhook from kneeling (main attacks). Volume 5 covers what to do when they knee cut against your underhook, back step, or go to reverse half. Volume 6 covers the sit-up guard and shin-to-shin (single leg and others). Volume 7 covers reverse De La Riva (spinning to the back). Volume 8 covers the Z guard and kimura, with narrated rolling.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - The Half G.for: No-gi half guard players of any level.

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles Analyzes His.overview: A single 24-minute video in which Lachlan Giles breaks down his ADCC 2019 absolute final against Gordon Ryan: the leg lock exchanges, the guard passing that followed, and how Gordon got to mount and the back. Gordon's own analysis of the same match is in My Evolution Your Revolution: ADCC 2019 (Volumes 6-7).
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles Analyzes His.for: Anyone interested in elite no-gi strategy; good alongside Gordon's version.
key: Lessons from losing to Gordon Ryan

Lachlan Giles Under The Legs Passing Ant.overview: Lachlan Giles' under-the-legs passing anthology, six parts (about 10 hours), designed for modern guards (K guard, inversions, leg lock hunters). Part 1 covers the overview and entries. Part 2 covers the single underhook pass. Part 3 covers the double underhook pass (with gi versus no-gi differences). Part 4 covers the over-under pass. Part 5 covers passing with the bicep ride. Part 6 covers the miragaia pass.
Lachlan Giles Under The Legs Passing Ant.for: Passers facing open guard players who invert and attack legs.

lovato - timeless-no-gi.overview: Rafael Lovato Jr's no-gi course from his championship career, six parts (about 4.5 hours). Part 1 covers the initial approach and winning the hand fight. Part 2 covers the knee tap and offence from the body lock. Part 3 covers wrestling essentials (including the 'spin cycle'). Part 4 covers body lock style passing and the knee cut. Part 5 covers the side smash and knee shield passing without wrist control. Part 6 covers the arm triangle and the opponent's reactions to it.
lovato - timeless-no-gi.for: No-gi players wanting a simple, pressure-based game; suits older grapplers.
key: Body lock passing and knee cut

Magid Hage Magid’s Abstract Armlocks.overview: Magid Hage's unconventional armlocks, four parts. Part 1 covers armlocks from mount. Part 2 covers side control armlocks (americana to armlock, margarida, deadlift armbar). Part 3 covers armlocks from passing (knee cut armlocks) and closed guard. Part 4 covers the reverse armlock, shotgun armbar and choi bar.
Magid Hage Magid’s Abstract Armlocks.for: Intermediate gi players who want fresh arm attacks from top.

Magid Hage The Best Of Both Worlds - Und.overview: Magid Hage on using underhooks and overhooks everywhere, six parts. Part 1 covers tools and concepts. Part 2 covers standing (underhooks). Parts 3 and 4 cover top position (underhooks, then overhooks). Parts 5 and 6 cover bottom (underhooks, then overhooks, including the overhook triangle from side control).
Magid Hage The Best Of Both Worlds - Und.for: Gi and no-gi players who want a principle-based upper body game.

Marcelo Garcia - Passing Guard.overview: Marcelo Garcia's 'Guard Passing Essentials', five parts (about 3h 20m); a second, lower-quality copy with labelled parts is in your library too. Part 1 covers closed guard fundamentals and breaks (hand control, standing press guard break). Part 2 covers his core passing system (kick-back pass, knee cut). Part 3 covers passing De La Riva (mounting the free DLR leg into a leg-over pass or knee cut). Part 4 covers hook control and half guard passing (pinning hooks into the inverted vault or leg-over pass). Part 5 covers advanced passing and guard clearing (near underhook to cross-body knee cut, arm trap and head control against half guard frames).
Marcelo Garcia - Passing Guard.for: Gi and no-gi passers who like Marcelo's mobile style.

Master The Move - The Knee Cut Guard Pas.overview: John Danaher's knee cut study, six volumes. Volume 1 covers the three-step knee cut system. Volume 2 covers the first type of knee cut you must master (underhook and post). Volume 3 covers knee cuts with greater connection. Volume 4 covers combining the knee cut with other passes (toreando to knee cut and others). Volume 5 is a special topic on the headquarters position (clearing a hand off your ankle). Volume 6 covers knee cut passing from the split squat (wrist pass, two-handed pass).
Master The Move - The Knee Cut Guard Pas.for: No-gi passers; one of the best single-pass courses.

Master The Move Butterfly Guard Sweep- J.overview: John Danaher's butterfly sweep (sumi gaeshi) study, six volumes. Volume 1 covers the essential mechanics of a strong sumi gaeshi. Volume 2 covers the rear deltoid and elbow grip version, and troubleshooting the elbow grip. Volume 3 covers specialised applications (double unders, arm trap front sumi gaeshi and others). Volume 4 covers using the sweep against realistic resistance. Volume 5 covers posting the elbow and head position. Volume 6 covers linking the sweep with submissions and leg locks.
Master The Move Butterfly Guard Sweep- J.for: No-gi butterfly and seated guard players.
